scope.summary: tools/run_nahw_evals.py --bank hover-context recomputes every row's key and requires a collision-reason row to actually collide with at least one listed sibling. Two rows cannot: an_vs_inna_norm_collapses_seat_unsafe (surface 'ان', siblings أَنْ/أَنَّ/إِنَّ/إِنْ) and umm_vs_am_unsafe (surface 'ام', siblings أُمّ/أَمْ/إِمَّا). The cause is measurable, not editorial: tools/normalize_ar.py norm() maps أ/إ/ء to the EMPTY string, so norm('أَنْ')='ن' while norm('ان')='ان'; norm_strict keeps the seat so 'أن' != 'ان'; bare() likewise. No key function in the repo makes the declared families collide. Repairing this requires either changing norm()'s hamza handling (repo-wide blast radius, owned by no naḥw lane) or re-specifying the rows' surfaces — a choice the repository does not determine, so A2 quarantined both rows with contract_status=pending_norm_seat_semantics rather than guess.
